spiritgiven.comments: Great game! Positive attitude and concern with collisions made it feel safe and competitive.

We had a close call for one of our players who was going up line and got clipped. He was scared due to a previous injury and emotions were increased. The other player did well keeping calm and our team recognized his attempt to pull up and avoid a dangerous play.
Great game and spirit. Good communication. Loved the energy and the continual checking in from both teams making sure both teams are on the same page. Good sideline conversation from both teams.
Great work in windy condition making it safer with the disc floating a lot more. Great attitude and grit on and off the field with great positivity.

Great competition! Resolution of calls were good even with language barriers. Contacted called and then violation due to not dropping count appropriately, rule was discussed with game advisor and resolved well!
It was a good game with our team mismatching gender and team Hong Kong being graceful in their acceptance of our apology. Great communication making sure everyone is respected!

We loved the grind this game. A lot of good communication and resulting of calls with hand signals. We had a couple of our handlers who had more contact and foul calls on the mark than usual with 4 in a single point from the same player. Overall great game!
Thank you for a great game. We had a wonderful time and enjoyed the great spirit, communication and sideline presence in the stadium. Fern has a great banner and everyone should see it.
Great spirit and consistent high-fiving and learning of names. We really appreciate the continual effort on and off the field. We were looking forward to this! Thank you so much for a great game.
Thank you for a great game! Good communication and spirit. Playing y’all a second time and seein y’all level up from the first game was amazing. Thank you for the new dance keeping us on our toes!

Thank you for a great game! I was given feedback after the game there was a lot of contact on the marks from our O handlers throughout the game. We appreciate the grind and the physicality Canada always brings. Opening up the field with your deep cuts and flow was hard to adjust to! Keep grinding and can’t wait to play against y'all again in the future!
Thank you again team Japan for another great game. We always know playing against you is going to be tough and we have to play our absolute best to win.

spiritreceived.comments: Overall it was a great intense game. Everything went as per our initial discussion. The USA team had good spirit and attitude towards the team was good
thank you for an intense game!
Thank you for actively trying to communicate with us from the early hours.
Thanks USA, that was a really fun game. We wanted to commend efforts to avoid contact and play a safe non-contact game.
It was a class act and a very pleasant game!
It was a good game overall. There were a few calls, but very quickly resolved.

Thank you for the great game! You guys were so fun and your smiles and communication were great. You guys are always updating the rules, which is great. There are two points I would like to make for improvement. First, we wanted to avoid contact during defense. Another thing I think is that uniform shirt and pants numbers should match. Let's meet again! Thank you.
